integrity: The code was reconstructed from the published polynomial and tail specification; all messages and all unordered pairs in the minimum shell were exhaustively checked. The computation supplements a symbolic lower-bound proof.
limitations: The result concerns one explicitly specified binary \([184,21,72]\) code, not all codes with those parameters.
Higher generalized Hamming weights \(d_r\) for \(r\ge3\) are not determined here.
An unindexed supplementary computation could independently contain the same invariant.
title: Second generalized Hamming weight of the new \([184,21,72]\) code
